title: ShareNet 2.0 Protocol Object Registry (FROZEN)
description: Canonical machine-readable registry of ALL normative protocol objects. Each object declares its kind (wire/state/rule/sub_object), maturity (reference-implemented/spec-frozen), conformance vector family, and spec reference. The completeness test derives its requirements from this file — adding a new wire object without a corresponding vector family MUST fail CI automatically.

object_kinds.wire: Object that crosses a process/network/language boundary. Requires a conformance vector family.
object_kinds.state: In-memory proof artifact (WeakSet-bound). Does NOT cross boundaries. No wire vector required, but behavior is tested by existing vectors.
object_kinds.rule: A protocol rule or invariant (e.g. propagation limits). Not an object. Tested by behavioral vectors.
object_kinds.sub_object: A structural sub-element of a wire object (e.g. RouteHop). Covered by the parent object's vector.

maturity_levels.reference-implemented: A TypeScript reference implementation exists in reference/. The vector is verified against the real implementation.
maturity_levels.spec-frozen: No TypeScript implementation exists yet. The vector freezes the canonical encoding from the spec. A future implementation MUST match these bytes.

NodeAdvertisement.description: Signed node advertisement with capabilities + endpoints

ShareNetAdvertisement.description: Spec CDDL name for NodeAdvertisement (spec/03 §3) — same object, covered by V-ADV

VerifiedNodeAdvertisement.description: WeakSet-verified advertisement proof artifact — not wire-serializable

AuthenticatedNodeRecord.description: WeakSet-registered authenticated node record — local proof artifact, not wire-serializable

InitiateMessage.description: Sub-message of LinkHandshake — covered by V-LINK-HANDSHAKE

AcceptMessage.description: Sub-message of LinkHandshake — covered by V-LINK-HANDSHAKE

ConfirmMessage.description: Sub-message of LinkHandshake — covered by V-LINK-HANDSHAKE

AuthenticatedLink.description: WeakSet-registered authenticated link artifact — local proof, not wire-serializable. Behavior tested by V-LINK-AUTH vectors.

RemoteNodeHint.description: Signed discovery hint with hopCount, freshness, nonce

HintBody.description: Canonical CBOR body of a RemoteNodeHint — covered by V-HINT

HintPropagationRules.description: MAX_HINT_HOPS, freshness decay, replay rejection — tested by V-TOPOLOGY-PROPAGATION behavioral vectors

CandidateDestination.description: Discovery output: node_id_hint, reported_by, endpoint_hints, distance_hint, last_seen, evidence_type (spec/05 §2). No TS implementation yet; vector freezes the canonical encoding.

RouteProposal.description: Unsigned inner proposal — covered by V-ROUTE-PROPOSAL (signed wire object)

SignedRouteProposal.description: Canonical signed wire object: { proposal, signature }

RouteHop.description: Hop descriptor sub-element — covered by V-ROUTE-COMMIT

RouteAcceptance.description: Per-hop signed acceptance binding proposal/hop/service digests

RouteCommitment.description: Merkle commitment root + source signature + commitment nonce

CommittedRoute.description: State object derived from RouteCommitment — the only input to circuit construction

PathValidationResult.description: Per-link measurement: RTT, loss, valid_until, source signature

ServiceAgreement.description: Negotiated service terms: capability, bandwidth, expiry, policyVersion

ServiceRequirement.description: Input to service negotiation — hashed into requirementDigest, covered by V-SVC

GatewayServiceAgreement.description: Spec/09 §3.1 dual-signed agreement with gateway + source signatures. The implementation uses ServiceAgreement (unsigned routing-internal); the spec-frozen vector freezes the normative dual-signed wire format. Structural reconciliation is future work.

CircuitId.description: BLAKE3-256 derivation + HKDF hop key derivation + nonce layout + replay guard

CircuitSetupRequest.description: Initiator→Relay setup message: route, hopIndex, initiator X25519 pubkey, nonce

CircuitSetupAck.description: Relay→Initiator ack: relay X25519 pubkey, possession proof, freshness bounds

CircuitPossessionProof.description: Relay's Ed25519 signature proving possession of the AEAD key — carried within CircuitSetupAck, tested by V-CIRCUIT-ACK vectors

CircuitFrame.description: Data-plane AEAD frame construction: nonce layout (route_id_prefix || frame_sequence), AD = domain || commitment_root || seq || direction. Not a separate typed object — the construction is tested by V-CIRCUIT nonce-layout and replay-guard vectors.

GatewayRequestFrame.description: CBOR-encoded request frame crossing the relay→gateway boundary

GatewayResponseFrame.description: CBOR-encoded response frame crossing the gateway→relay→source boundary

ServiceMeasurement.description: Signed gateway service measurement (bytes sent/received, timestamps, HTTP status)

GatewayAuditEvent.description: Structured audit event with dedicated signature domain

GatewayCapacity.description: In-memory capacity state — not wire-serialized, tested by V-GATEWAY policy vectors

GatewayCapability.description: Self-attested INTERNET_GATEWAY capability in NodeAdvertisement — covered by V-ADV + V-GATEWAY

GatewayAuthorization.description: Signed authorization statement that a specific NodeId is permitted to use the gateway. Crosses a trust boundary. No TS implementation exists; the spec-frozen vector freezes the canonical encoding. Future implementation MUST match.

BilateralReceipt.description: Dual-signed receipt: gateway + peer signatures over service session

ContributionProof.description: Derived proof from verified receipt: receiptHash, contributor, bytesForwarded

LedgerEntry.description: Ledger entry wrapping a ContributionProof with sequence + timestamp — covered by V-CONTRIBUTION-PROOF. Note: spec/11 §4 defines a hash-chained variant; the implementation uses a simpler append-only structure. Structural reconciliation is future work.
